title: PM Shehbaz arrives in New York to attend UN General Assembly session

article.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in New York to attend UN General Assembly session
article.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in the United States on Monday to attend a high-level segment of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York. According to the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), the prime minister landed in New York to participate in the session, which will be held from Sept 21 to 25. He is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Sept 25. On the sidelines of the session, PM Shehbaz is also expected to hold bilateral meetings with world leaders and participate in high-level events. He will also present Pakistan’s perspective on regional and global developments and highlight the country’s priorities at the UNGA. The premier was received at the airport by Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Asim Iftikhar Ahmad. The premier had on Thursday reached London for a two-day stopover before proceeding to the United States. Meanwhile, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar arrived in New York ahead of the premier to participate in the UNGA session, the Foreign Office (FO) said on Monday.
